subject: Hosted API pricing qualification: expected monthly token volume + peak TPS
messages:
From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmeapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-18T15:12:00Z
Subject: Hosted API pricing follow-up — token volumes & peak TPS (post-call)

Hi Samir — great talking earlier. Quick recap and next steps on the Hosted API pricing side.

Recap from our call:
- Primary use case: in-app assistant for customer support (short prompts + multi-turn context).
- Target latency: <300ms 95th for single-turn responses.
- Integration: Hosted API initially; may consider Dedicated in 6-12 months depending on volume.

Open items we discussed that I promised to follow up on:
1) Expected monthly token volume (both input + output) — rough ranges are fine.
2) Peak TPS (concurrent requests/sec or tokens/sec during peak minute).
3) Budget range / target $ per 1M tokens — we can map to plan recommendations.

Action items:
- Samir: share a recent token usage export or ballpark monthly figure. If you can, attach a sample CSV with hourly token counts — that'll let us model unit economics.
- Marissa: send a rough pricing model and target $/1M tokens bands based on volume buckets.
- Ben: I'll loop you in for a quick pricing check once Samir shares numbers.

I attached a quick token-report template (acme_token_report.csv) you can fill — feel free to paste numbers inline if easier.

Thanks — talk soon.

Best,
Marissa Cole
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com

From: Samir Patel <samir@acmeapps.com>
To: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Priya Singh <priya.s@acmeapps.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T10:03:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up — token volumes & peak TPS

Marissa — thanks for the recap and the template. Attaching our export (acme_token_report.csv). Quick answers inline: 

- Monthly token volume (input + output combined): currently ~14M tokens/month. This is early prod: we project 40-60M tokens/month within 6 months if adoption goes well.
- Peak TPS (short spikes during business hours): about 6 requests/sec at peak; about ~45 tokens/request average so ~270 tokens/sec peak.
- Budget: we have an initial monthly budget of $3k- $6k for API costs while we validate; long-term budget TBD depending on unit economics. Our procurement target is to keep < $200 / 1M tokens as a benchmark.

Let me know if you need the export in a different shape.

Cheers,
Samir
Head of Product, Acme Apps
samir@acmeapps.com

From: Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmeapps.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>, Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-19T16:40:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up — token volumes & peak TPS

Thanks Samir — this is super helpful. A few follow-ups so we can model costs for both current and projected volumes: 

1) Can you confirm the 45 tokens/request average is across both input+output? If you have separate input vs output averages that helps (e.g., input 15 tokens / output 30 tokens).
2) For the projected 40-60M tokens/month, do you expect the peak TPS to scale proportionally or remain similar (i.e., more sustained traffic vs higher spikes)?
3) Procurement: if $200 / 1M tokens is your target, I want to show a quick map of what that implies for hosted pricing today vs Dedicated/reserved guidance.

I'm attaching a short pricing sketch (rdw_pricing_sheet.pdf) that shows our hosted API unit bands and example monthly costs for 10M / 50M / 100M tokens. This is for internal planning — final pricing would be in the quote.

If it's useful, Ben can propose a targeted unit price for the 40-60M band and also flag any available trial credits to keep you within the $3k- $6k initial window while you validate usage.

Would you be open to a 20-min sync tomorrow to run through the numbers?

Best,
Marissa
Enterprise Sales, Redwood Inference

Attachments: rdw_pricing_sheet.pdf

From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.com>
To: Samir Patel <samir@acmeapps.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.com>
Cc: Alex Martinez <alex@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-02-20T09:45:00Z
Subject: Re: Hosted API pricing follow-up — token volumes & peak TPS

Hey Samir — looping in quickly with a pricing sanity check and next steps.

Thanks for the numbers. A few notes on unit economics and options to hit your $/1M target: 
- At 14M tokens/month on hosted plans, typical list pricing (public bands) maps to roughly $250- $350 per 1M tokens depending on model family and streaming vs non-streaming patterns. That would put your current spend estimate around $3.5k- $5k/mo, which aligns to your $3k- $6k initial budget.
- If you scale to 40-60M tokens/month, we can propose a volume band that approaches $150- $200 per 1M tokens depending on committed volume and a short-term reserved commitment. That gets you into your procurement target range.
- For peak TPS: 6 RPS and ~270 tokens/sec peak is small for Hosted; latency and autoscaling should be fine. If you expect higher simultaneous spikes (e.g., 20-30 RPS short bursts), we should size for that in the SLA/throughput guidance.

Proposed next steps:
1) Samir to confirm input vs output token split (Marissa — helped on the template).
2) Samir to confirm whether projected 40-60M is expected across sustained traffic or short bursts.
3) Ben to provide a targeted pricing band for 40-60M tokens and a short trial credit to keep initial spend within $3k- $6k while you validate (I’ll draft by EOD).

If you’re good, book a 20-min slot and we’ll run a simple model live.

Best,
Ben Carter
Sales Engineering, Redwood Inference
ben@redwood.com
